facts: Kittens do best with several small meals a day.
Most grown-up cats do well with two meals a day.
Older cats often do well with two or three smaller meals.
Cats need fresh water every day.
Short play sessions suit most cats better than one long one.
A steady daily routine helps cats feel safe.
Gentle play is kinder for kittens and older cats.
Changes at the litter box are worth watching.
